thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a midnight incremental reboot window for az3-gpu pool tonight 00:00–02:00 UTC. Expect low traffic but want to coordinate canaries/backfill and tenant comms. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/reboot-az3 (short checklist).
chris: ETA on capacity hit? how many nodes out at a time?
maria: We'll do cohorts of 6 nodes, staggered 15m. Targeting ~10% capacity impact at peak for the pool, should be covered by burst backfill.
devon: Canary plan: 3 nodes in cohort0 will be rebooted first, run healthchecks + kv-prime. If canaries pass for 20m we continue. I will run the canary checks.
nashley: Customer comms — any tenants flagged as high-priority that need explicit notice?
maria: @ashley only two enterprise-tenants on az3: Acme and NovaCorp. We'll send targeted email with fallback instructions. No SLA downtime expected, but callouts about possible transient latency.
nick: Cost note — if we rely on cross-region backfill we incur egress + transient peak GPU hours. Estimate ~ $4k worst-case for 2h if we push to eu-west2. Want sign-off?
maria: Aware. prefer to avoid cross-region unless canaries fail. If we spillover >15% we'll enable the cross-region route.
ops-bot: maintenance-scheduler: Maintenance window created by @maria for sources:az3-gpu on 7832104444. Start 00:00 UTC, end 02:00 UTC. Notifying on-call.
chris: any network prep? last time we saw BGP flaps when multiple racks cycled.
devon: Network team asked to have the aggregation switches in passive monitoring mode; verify eBGP timers and suppress flap alerts during the window. Also will run a light traffic soak pre-window:
```
# soak command
./traffic-soak --pool az3-gpu --duration 10m --qps 50
```
maria: Steps for ops team (short): cordon -> graceful drain -> reboot -> kv-prime -> healthcheck -> uncordon. If healthcheck fails revert cohort and re-route.
chris: Healthchecks defined as: kernel logs clean, GPU temp < 70C, driver ping ok, all containers Ready for 5 consecutive polls.
devon: For kv-prime please run prefix-cache seed after reboot to avoid cold-token latency. I'll push the seed script ~5m after node returns.
nashley: I'll draft the targeted notice and post in #customer-notices at T-2h. Also will flag status page to prepare a banner in case of visible latency.
nick: Small ask — can we throttle non-critical batch jobs during the window to reduce backfill need?
maria: Yep, throttling batch jobs scheduled. I'll add a temporal policy to reduce batch concurrency from 8 -> 2 in az3 for window.
chris: Rollback plan?
maria: If canaries fail or network is noisy: pause window, uncordon any remaining nodes, reassign running tenants to standby racks, and escalate to network and hardware oncall. We'll open a postmortem if rollback needed.
devon: I'll be online for canary + kv-prime. chris, can you own network verification?
chris: Yup.
maria: Final: I'm on-call and will lead the ops channel during the window. Ping me @maria on call if anything odd. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: 15m until maintenance window for 7832104444.
nashley: Posted customer notice. Link: https://status.internal/notice/7832104444
maria: Thanks team — see you at 23:50 UTC for the preflight check-in.
